summary: The Essence Refinery processes raw Discord energy into refined corruption essence. The refinery’s conduits pulse with unstable power, and Discord‑forged engineers struggle to maintain control.
history: Raw Discord essence was discovered beneath the plains.
Refinery conduits were built to extract and refine it.
Corruption essence became vital to War‑Shade empowerment.
Refinery overloads reshaped the region multiple times.
